effect_description_eng:
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, if a Tamer card with the [SoC] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gains "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks."
